stop_reason: No exercise contrast in the sequenced samples: GSE282166 contains only AAV8-irisin-Flag vs AAV8-GFP EAE mice (sorted NeuN+/NeuN- spinal cord nuclei). No running/sedentary animals were sequenced; the paper's exercise-vs-sedentary experiments (FIG1, FIG5) are histology/qPCR only and its running transcriptome comparison uses external data (Sun et al., CRA007207). Irisin overexpression is a hormone-delivery intervention, not exercise, so the requested estimand (how exercise affects gene expression) is not identifiable from these data.
